input.question: What is the population of Young America Township?

documents.text: Young America Township, Edgar County, Illinois Young America Township is one of fifteen townships in Edgar County, Illinois, USA. As of the 2010 census, its population was 726 and it contained 364 housing units. In the early 19th century, the current Young America township and the current Shiloh Township comprised a single township, known as Bull Head Township. According to the 2010 census, the township has a total area of , all land. The township contains Young America Cemetery.
